security_spec.violation_condition: Kernel sets MTAG=1 in a first-stage PTE whose X (execute) bit is also 1, without explicitly intending that code page to be a tagcheck-exempt region — causing all loads/stores issued by code on that page to silently bypass tag checks.
security_spec.summary: MTAG=1 on executable pages creates tagcheck-exempt regions that silently disable tag checks for all memory accesses originating from that code — accidental MTAG propagation to executable PTEs enables undetected memory corruption bypass paths.
